thesis: The episode introduces Savneet Singh, the president and CEO of PAR Technology Corp and a partner at CoVenture, who previously co-founded GBI and Tara Holdings. The conversation covers Singh's early interest in business starting with a baseball card business on eBay, his transition from investment banking at Morgan Stanley to becoming an operator, and his views on investing and technology trends.
